<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import csv
import os

# Read the input matrix
input_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
id_columns = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]
indicator_columns = [col for col in df.columns if col not in id_columns]

# Compute missingness per indicator
total_rows = len(df)
missingness_data = []

for indicator in indicator_columns:
    missing_count = df[indicator].isna().sum()
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_rows if total_rows > 0 else 0.0
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    missingness_data.append({
        "indicator": indicator,
        "missing_count": int(missing_count),
        "missing_rate": missing_rate,
        "kept": kept
    })

# Create missingness report DataFrame
missingness_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness_data)

# Write missingness report
output_report_path = "outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv"
with open(output_report_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
    # Write header
    writer.writerow(["indicator", "missing_count", "missing_rate", "kept"])
    # Write data rows
    for _, row in missingness_df.iterrows():
        writer.writerow([row["indicator"], row["missing_count"], row["missing_rate"], row["kept"]])

# Select indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
kept_indicators = missingness_df[missingness_df["kept"]]["indicator"].tolist()

# Create selected matrix
selected_columns = id_columns + kept_indicators
selected_df = df[selected_columns]

# Write selected matrix
output_matrix_path = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"
with open(output_matrix_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
    # Write header
    writer.writerow(selected_columns)
    # Write data rows
    for _, row in selected_df.iterrows():
        writer.writerow(row.tolist())

print(f"Missingness report written to {output_report_path}")
print(f"Selected matrix written to {output_matrix_path}")
print(f"Total indicators: {len(indicator_columns)}")
print(f"Kept indicators: {len(kept_indicators)}")
print(f"Kept indicator names: {kept_indicators}")
</solution_file>
